name: Lymphoedema
summary: Management combines skin care, compression, exercise, specialised massage and self-care taught by trained therapists, with careful screening to exclude clots, infection and recurrent disease.

looksLike: Swelling pattern, measurements and skin changes
History of cancer treatment, surgery or infection
Skin condition and signs of infection
Function, range of movement and pain
redFlags: Hot, red, painful limb with fever (cellulitis)
New unexplained swelling in someone with cancer
Heart failure or kidney disease as the cause
firstSteps: Measure the limb, check the skin and exclude red-flag causes of swelling.
Teach skin care, compression and gentle exercise.
selfCare: Avoid cuts, burns, injections and tight clothing on the affected limb where advised
